item.description:

PS-318: Reconstruction of Paerdegat Pumping Station Paerdegat pumping station is located in Brooklyn, New York at 6002 Flatlands Ave, Brooklyn, New York that flows to the Coney Island Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility. The Pumping Station was constructed in 1932 with an upgrade completed in 1995. The station currently has a designed flow capacity of 57 million gallons per day (MGD) wet weather flow and 22.8 MGD dry weather flow. The existing station is in need of State of Good Repair (SOGR) upgrades in order to improve compliance with DEPs SOPs and design guidelines. item.title: Mayor's Office of Mass Engagement - SMS Service Provider RFEI
item.description:
Economic Development Corporation | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-06 In plain English (machine-written): The Economic Development Corporation is seeking information from companies that offer unified text messaging and phone outreach platforms for the Mayor's Office of Mass Engagement's public awareness campaigns, with responses due Nov. 6, 2026.

New York City Economic Development Corporation (NYCEDC) in collaboration with the Mayors Office of Mass Engagement seeks information from qualified respondents on unified Text Messaging and Phone Outreach platforms.

Mayor Mamdani established the Office of Mass Engagement to transform how New Yorkers engage with their government, opening a direct line of communication between the Mayor, his team, and the people who built this city and keep it running. item.description:

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) intends to enter into negotiations for a six-year agreement with Biolytical Laboratories Inc. to provide INSTI® HIV-1/HIV-2 Rapid Antibody Tests and INSTI® HIV-1/HIV-2 Test Controls on an as needed basis. These products will be utilized by DOHMH's Bureau of HIV's Field Services Unit and in DOHMH`s Sexually Transmitted Disease (STD) Clinics throughout NYC for rapid detection of HIV antibodies.  

DOHMH has determined that Biolytical Laboratories Inc. is the sole source provider of these products. BioLytical Laboratories Inc. is the sole manufacturer and seller of the branded INSTI® HIV Test, all INSTI® HIV Test products are manufactured and sold exclusively by BioLytical Laboratories Inc. and must be purchased directly from them. There are no resellers or distributors for these products. 

Any firm that believes it can legally provide these goods, is invited to submit an Expression of Interest directly to this RFI- EPIN 81627Y0870 no later than 10/23/2026 by 2:00PM.
